# Retired words: one row per word, then the allowlist of places that still carry it.
#
# word <retired word> => <what replaced it>
#   text file except the dated records: CHANGELOG.md, RESOLUTIONS.md, docs/RELEASE-NOTES-*,
#   docs/ratings/, anything under a testdata/ directory, and the three terminology pages
#   (docs/TERMINOLOGY.md, docs/GLOSSARY.md, docs/sprint/GLOSSARY.md), which name retired words
#   on purpose to say what replaced them.
#
# allow <word> <path> <count>
#   A shrink-only ledger: the file still carries <count> uses of the word. A path with more is
#   a new use and fails; a path with fewer fails until its row is lowered or deleted. A row is
#   a place still to be fixed, never a parking place; a new row is a refusal.
word asleep => down (the friend health table's word since 2026-10-03; Glenn: "Please change 'asleep' to 'down' so we have consistency across all tables")
